evidence.supports: Ordinance adopted 2026-01-08 permanently bars commercial data centers of 2 MW or more from all zoning districts, effective immediately; no sunset.
evidence.quote: bars commercial data centers with a peak power demand of 2 megawatts or greater from all zoning districts in Clay County's unincorporated areas

evidence.supports: County ordinance index listing the data center ordinance.

decisions.notes: REMOVE: permanent ban, no pause element. Ordinance No. 01.08.2026 prohibits commercial data centers of 2 MW or more in every zoning district, with no sunset or study period, and the row itself says 'Indefinite prohibition, not a temporary moratorium'. The paired crypto prohibition is also permanent. aigridwatch and the NC newsletter are right.

evidence.supports: Ordinance text: amends Cherokee Code Chapter 47E to prohibit data centers on EBCI Tribal lands, 'in effect indefinitely', with no study directive or end condition.
evidence.publisher: Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians Tribal Council
evidence.quote: A data center as defined in subsection (d) is hereby prohibited on EBCI Tribal lands ... (f) This moratorium shall remain in effect indefinitely.

evidence.supports: Adopted 5/7/26 as Ordinance No. 158(2026), 'AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 47E TO BAN DATA CENTERS ON EBCI TRIBAL LANDS.'

decisions.notes: REMOVE: a permanent ban in substance. Ordinance No. 158(2026) is titled as a ban and adds a standing prohibition to the Cherokee Code, 'in effect indefinitely', with no sunset, no study period and no end event. Only the wording of section 47E-5 calls it a 'moratorium'. The coordinator removed the Fallon Paiute-Shoshone and Pyramid Lake Paiute tribal bans on the same grounds. Borderline because the instrument calls itself a moratorium; if the coordinator keeps indefinite self-described moratoria, keep this row as it is (active, indefinite).

evidence.supports: On 2026-04-16 Clyde adopted a 12-month moratorium; the mayor pro tem said a moratorium must be temporary (about one year max).
evidence.quote: shall not accept, process or approve any application for zoning permits ... for the construction, establishment or expansion of a data center within the town

decisions.notes: aigridwatch is wrong or conflating instruments. Its 'permanent ban, 2026-01-14 zoning amendment' matches no instrument found; the adopted instrument is a 12-month moratorium (2026-04-16). A later Mountaineer story ('Clyde overhauls zoning ordinance', paywalled, archived stub) may cover a zoning rewrite that addresses data centers. If that rewrite prohibits them, a later pass should consider 'replaced'. No evidence of that as of 2026-09-23.
